product_family: Outreach is an agentic AI revenue orchestration platform for sales engagement, deal management, conversation intelligence, forecasting, and account management; core sub-products include Outreach Voice (calling/recording), Outreach Omni, Agent Studio, Meeting Prep Agent, and Outreach MCP (integration layer for connecting the platform to other GTM tools/agents).

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type II
certifications.proof_quote: SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, ISO 27701, EU-U.S. Privacy Shield, and TRUSTe certifications

certifications.name: ISO 27001
certifications.proof_quote: Outreach has determined that our current security and data privacy controls, and certifications including ISO 27001 and ISO 27701, allow Outreach to adhere to the GDPR's requirements. Outreach maintains ISO 27001 certification (since 2015).

certifications.name: ISO 27701 (Privacy Information Management)
certifications.proof_quote: GDPR compliance requirements are built into the control framework Outreach is audited against as a part of our ISO 27701 certification.

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 42001 (AI Management System)
certifications.proof_quote: Outreach became the first revenue technology company to achieve ISO/IEC 42001:2023 certification... ISO 42001 joins SOC 2 Type II, HIPAA, ISO/IEC 27001, and ISO/IEC 27701 in Outreach's compliance portfolio. Date achieved: July 15, 2025.

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: Outreach maintains a HIPAA attestation and offers BAAs to customers who require them and meet specific requirements. Customers who have not executed a BAA are not permitted to store, process, or transmit protected health information (PHI) within the Outreach platform.

certifications.name: CSA STAR (Cloud Security Alliance)
certifications.proof_quote: Trust page lists a 'Cloud Security Alliance (CSA)' heading followed by 'Security, Trust, Assurance, and Risk (STAR)' among Outreach's certifications, confirmed present on the vendor Trust page.

certifications.name: PCI DSS
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of PCI DSS on Outreach's trust, security, or GDPR pages; not applicable as Outreach does not appear to process cardholder payment data as a core function.

certifications.name: FedRAMP
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of FedRAMP authorization on any Outreach-owned page.

certifications.name: ISO 27017 / ISO 27018 (Cloud security / PII in cloud)
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of ISO 27017 or ISO 27018 specifically; Outreach's listed cloud-related certifications are ISO 27001 and ISO 27701 only.

certifications.name: EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework / Privacy Shield
certifications.proof_quote: SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, ISO 27701, EU-U.S. Privacy Shield, and TRUSTe certifications; Data transfers from EU/UK/Switzerland use standard contractual clauses and EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework compliance.

privacy.ai_training_note: Outreach's ML models are trained on aggregated behavioral/usage signals ('3 billion+ signals used to train Outreach machine learning models', '33+ million action-outcome pairings captured weekly' per outreach.ai/platform/sales-ai), governed by 'customers' contractual commitments' rather than a documented self-serve opt-out. One narrow carve-out is explicit: 'Google Workspace Data is not used to develop, improve, or train AI and/or ML models' (privacy-statement). No public page states a blanket opt-out for all AI training on customer content; customers should confirm training scope/opt-out in their MSA and the AI Data Use Whitepaper (available only via Account Management, not public).
privacy.data_region: US-hosted (AWS) by default; an EU data center is available for customers requiring EU data tenancy ('Outreach's EU data center is available cross-platform for customers who require EU data tenancy' - outreach.ai/gdpr). EU/UK/Swiss transfers use SCCs and EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework.

security.name: Encryption in transit
security.value: Data is encrypted in transit using industry-leading encryption standards.

security.name: Encryption at rest
security.value: Data is encrypted at rest using industry-leading encryption standards.

security.name: Cloud infrastructure
security.value: Production infrastructure hosted on Amazon Web Services (AWS) as primary IaaS provider.

security.name: Penetration testing
security.value: Outreach contracts with industry-leading penetration testing providers to examine production architecture at least once a year.

security.name: Bug bounty
security.value: Outreach employs a private bug bounty program with security researchers testing the platform continuously.

security.name: Access controls
security.value: Granular role-based access controls; admins can define who can view, edit, or share content and grant/deny record visibility.

security.name: AI agent governance
security.value: Configurable agent controls define what agents can and can't do, with full audit trails for every action taken (per homepage; not independently detailed on the governance page beyond data/access controls).

security.name: Data residency controls
security.value: Customers can control retention of voice recordings, meeting recordings, and emails; EU citizen data can be hosted in the EU data center.

security.name: SSO
security.value: Enterprise-grade encryption, SSO, and role-based access controls built to secure revenue data (per homepage marketing copy; not independently detailed with a protocol list on a dedicated security page).

security.name: Trust center access
security.value: Full certification documents, whitepapers, diagrams, and questionnaire responses are gated behind account executive / account management contact, not publicly downloadable.

products.name: Outreach Core Platform (Sales Engagement / Deal Management)
products.data_scope: CRM records, email, calendar, deal/pipeline data
products.notes: Primary enterprise product; SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, ISO 27701 apply.

products.name: Outreach Voice
products.data_scope: Call recordings, voice transcripts, consent-to-record data
products.notes: Consent-to-record is customizable per local regulation; retention configurable by admins.

products.name: Outreach AI Agents / Agent Studio / Sales AI
products.data_scope: Aggregated behavioral signals, action-outcome data used for ML training
products.notes: Newly ISO/IEC 42001-certified (AI management system, July 2025); training governed by contract terms, no public self-serve opt-out documented.

products.name: Outreach MCP
products.data_scope: Cross-tool GTM data flow for agent actions
products.notes: New capability enabling agents to act across connected tools; no distinct compliance documentation found separate from core platform.

products.name: Healthcare / regulated-industry use (via BAA)
products.category: Sales tool used by healthcare sales teams
products.data_scope: Incidental/unintended PHI only; not designed to store PHI
products.notes: HIPAA attestation + BAA available on request; customers without an executed BAA are NOT permitted to store, process, or transmit PHI in the platform. Outreach is explicitly a sales workflow tool, not a healthcare data system.

compare.pricing_model: Enterprise B2B contract/quote-based (per-seat, tiered by platform capability); no self-serve public pricing found on captured/fetched pages.
compare.data_residency: US (AWS) default; optional EU data center for EU data tenancy; SCCs + EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework for cross-border transfers.

flags: Full trust-center documentation (audit reports, questionnaires) is gated behind 'contact your Account Executive' - not independently verifiable by AIFOXX beyond the public marketing-page claims.

HIPAA is an attestation with an optional BAA, not a formal government certification. The product is not designed to store PHI, and customers without an executed BAA are prohibited from putting PHI into the platform. This is conditional, use-case-limited HIPAA support rather than unconditional HIPAA compliance.

No public, customer-facing opt-out exists for AI/ML training on general product usage data; only Google Workspace data has an explicit no-train carve-out. Training is governed by contractual commitments rather than a documented default-off or self-serve toggle.
The CSA STAR listing is sourced from a single vendor page (platform/trust) and has not been cross-confirmed on a second Outreach-owned page or the CSA STAR public registry.
